svg.title: P12: Coordinator–worker spawn flow collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A1 · fork join role collaboration
A coordinator delegates a bounded task to another
A worker is spawned, called as a tool, or handed a
Worker output returns to the coordinator with
Parent and child identities, task scope,
and shared data policy are known.
Each worker has one task record, bounded
1 spawn(task) → 2 create(envelope) → 3 assign(task) → 4 return(result) → 5 report(failure) → 6 aggregate(results)
Evidence: 41/41 repositories, 36/36 families; 41 trajectories (19 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Sub-agent, agent-as-tool, background agent, child session, and worker pool.
Negative control: Sequential calls to independent agents without delegation do not count.
